profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point in downtown Albuquerque, New Mexico, tagged telecom=data_center, is named 505 Marquette, matching the street address 505 Marquette Avenue NW, a well-known office tower in downtown Albuquerque. Buildings named simply for their own street address are a common pattern for multi-tenant office towers, not for purpose-built data centers, which are almost always given a distinctive operator or campus brand name instead. The telecom=data_center tag on this record most likely reflects a telecommunications equipment room or meet-me room within the office tower, used to bring connectivity into the building for its tenants, rather than the building itself functioning as a colocation or cloud data-center business. This entry documents that likely mistag honestly rather than inventing data-center specifications for what is, in substance, a downtown office building.

This facility cannot be evaluated. The operator is not published, no power capacity is published, no IT load is published, and no certifications are published. Without these facts, no comparison to other campuses is possible.

New Mexico has 14 mapped data center facilities and zero published megawatts of capacity across all of them. This campus is one of 14 and ranks first only because no facility in the state has disclosed power figures to any operator spec page this site has read.

A reader deciding whether this campus matters to AI has no published data on which to base that decision. Future research with access to operator contact information or a working search tool may be able to resolve the operator identity and retrieve specifications.
